insight: Amazon agreed to acquire Bee in July 2025, signaling its return to AI wearables; the startup had raised about $7M.
name: Bee
tagline: Wrist-worn personal AI that listens to your day and remembers it for you.
description: Bee is an ambient personal-AI wearable: a $49.99 wristband (the Bee Pioneer) with dual microphones that continuously records and transcribes the conversations around you, then surfaces summaries, to-dos, reminders, and personal insights in its companion app. It connects to email and calendar so it can draft messages and create events from what it hears. The device works without a mandatory subscription; an optional premium tier unlocks advanced search and specialized agents.

modelSupport.notes: Vendor-managed cloud LLMs; no user model selection.

edge: One of the cheapest always-listening AI wearables — a $49.99 wristband with no mandatory subscription, unlike pendant rivals.
pros: Dual mics transcribe your whole day
Drafts emails and calendar events from speech
cons: Ships only to the United States
Premium features gated behind a subscription
